aliases: WordPress Gutenberg plugin <= 13.7.3 - Authenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability

vulnerabilities.summary: The Gutenberg plugin through 13.7.3 for WordPress allows stored XSS by the Contributor role via an SVG document to the "Insert from URL" feature. vulnerabilities.id: Gutenberg 12.9.0 - 18.0.0 - Unauthenticated & Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Avatar Block
aliases: Gutenberg 12.9.0 - 18.0.0 - Unauthenticated & Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Avatar Block
vulnerabilities.summary: The Gutenberg plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via user display names in the Avatar block in versions 12.9.0 to 18.0.0 due to insufficient output escaping on the display name. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.  In addition, it also makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that have the comment block present and display the comment author's avatar.
vulnerabilities.match: component slug matched; installed version unknown, range not verified
